args.title: Parse the header row with splitFields so quoted column names work
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

parseStatement builds the header with `lines[0].split(",")`, a plain comma split, instead of the quote-aware `splitFields` used for every data row. When the header line is double-quoted (e.g. `"Date","Amount","Description","Reference"`), each resulting header token still carries its surrounding quotes, so none of it matches REQUIRED_COLUMNS and assertShape throws "errors.rowShape" at row 1, even though the data rows would parse fine. Change the header line to use `splitFields(lines[0]).map(h => h.toLowerCase())` instead of `lines[0].split(",")`.

parseStatement splits the header line with a plain `lines[0].split(",")` instead of the quote-aware `splitFields` used for every data row. When the header is quoted (`"Date","Amount",...`), the quotes stay attached to each header name, so it never matches REQUIRED_COLUMNS and assertShape rejects the file at row 1, even though quoted data rows parse fine via splitFields. The fix is to parse the header with splitFields too.
